claim: Deterministic CPU qualification of a named model arithmetic contract, not native kernel equivalence or trained model accuracy

generation.X: PCG64 random float64 in [0,1), affine uniform [-1,1), cast FP32 then BF16 RNE; generate [128,2560], use row prefixes
generation.weights: Independent PCG64 random float64, affine uniform [-sqrt(3/K),sqrt(3/K)), cast FP32 then BF16 RNE, stored mathematical [K,N] C order
generation.input_of_fp64_algebra: The exact same BF16-representable X and weights as the quantized contract; no down-input cast in this source-algebra oracle

gemm.multiplicands: BF16 values represented exactly as FP32
gemm.within_block: Adjacent pairwise binary tree over 32 products: (0+1),(2+3),... at level 1; every addition rounds FP32
gemm.between_blocks: FP32 accumulator starts +0; add each block result in increasing K block order with a separate FP32 add
gemm.reassociation: Forbidden; candidate split-K must preserve this tree and block accumulation order
gemm.independent_checker: Streaming binary carry tree over individual K products; separate from materialized-product pair reduction
gemm.blas: Only FP64 source algebra uses BLAS. FP32 BLAS is not an implementation of this contract

pointwise.silu: For FP32 x>=0: e=round32(exp64(-float64(x))), d=round32(1+e), s=round32(x/d). For x<0: e=round32(exp64(float64(x))), n=round32(x*e), d=round32(1+e), s=round32(n/d). exp64 uses host double libm; independent implementation uses scalar math.exp and scalar operations, each rounded FP32
pointwise.down_input: A16=BF16 round-to-nearest-even(A32), then exact FP32 representation for CPU arithmetic
pointwise.output: Complete [M,2560] FP32 output, no output BF16 cast
pointwise.not_claimed: No guarantee of bit identity with any native SFPU or library kernel

padding.rule: Explicit positive-zero M padding to ceil(M/32)*32. H and I are divisible by 32. Run padded rows and verify they remain zero; expose all padded MACs to the performance model
padding.mask: Only original M rows are module outputs; padding initialization and relevant storage/movement must be charged by physical plans

acceptance.independent_quantized_contract: All BF16 conversions, G/U/S/A16/Y arrays bitwise equal between independent implementations, including full output for M=1,32,128; disagreement fails and is not hidden by source-algebra tolerance
acceptance.pointwise_relative_error: Report max but do not use as pass condition near zero
adversarial_unit_cases: BF16 independent rounding on 100000 finite FP32 bit patterns
FP32 tree cancellation and forbidden reassociation
SiLU signed zero and magnitudes up to 100
mutation: omitted down-input cast must alter output

service_inventory.explicit_cast: M*I FP32-to-BF16 conversions, reading 4*M*I bytes and logically producing 2*M*I bytes; fusion may avoid physical materialization, not arithmetic work
